## History

Carrie Sloane was among the students who threw themselves into excited preparations for a [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert organized by their teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md), to raise money for a school flag. Later, as part of a committee of girls from the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), she unsuccessfully attempted to persuade [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) not to rent his fence to a medicine company for painted advertisements.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010), [v1 CHAPTER XXIV.
